yaml
name: deepwiki-crawler
description: >
  Use this skill when the user provides a deepwiki.com link and wants the AI to fetch all
  subpages, translate them to Hungarian, and save them into a single coherent .md file.
  It should also activate when the user uses words like "deepwiki", "repo wiki translation",
  "wiki crawl", "wiki download", "deepwiki download", or provides a deepwiki.com URL.
  This skill is necessary because deepwiki.com is a JavaScript-rendered page — with plain
  HTTP requests the content is not, or only partially accessible, therefore a special
  fetching strategy must be applied.


 DeepWiki Crawler & Hungarian Translator Skill

 Purpose

Fetches all subpages of a given deepwiki.com/owner/repo URL, translates them to Hungarian,
and organizes them into a single coherent Markdown file — without source citations,
references, and external links.



 1. Input

The user provides a deepwiki.com URL, e.g.:


[https://deepwiki.com/facebook/react](https://deepwiki.com/facebook/react)




 2. Crawling Strategy (JSrendered page)

deepwiki.com is JavaScriptrendered — the content is not accessible with simple HTML fetching.
Apply two approaches in order:

 2a. Primary method: web_fetch in markdown mode

Most deepwiki pages are built with SSR (serverside rendering) or static generation,
so the web_fetch tool with html_extraction_method: "markdown" option usually works.


URL to fetch: [https://deepwiki.com/owner/repo](https://deepwiki.com/owner/repo)
Method: web_fetch, markdown extraction


If the main page returns content (not empty/error page), continue with mapping the navigation.

 2b. Fallback method: raw HTML + script tag mining

If markdown extraction returns an empty page, fetch the raw HTML and look for the following:
 <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> — on Next.js pages all content is in JSON
 window.__INITIAL_STATE__ or similar global variables
 data-page or data-content attributes

deepwiki is typically Next.js based, so the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag contains
all wiki content and navigation structure in JSON format.

 2c. Subpage discovery

From the page navigation (sidebar/menu), collect all subpage URLs.
Typical deepwiki URL structure:


[https://deepwiki.com/owner/repo](https://deepwiki.com/owner/repo)                    ← main page
[https://deepwiki.com/owner/repo/getting-started](https://deepwiki.com/owner/repo/getting-started)    ← subpage
[https://deepwiki.com/owner/repo/api-reference](https://deepwiki.com/owner/repo/api-reference)      ← subpage
[https://deepwiki.com/owner/repo/architecture](https://deepwiki.com/owner/repo/architecture)       ← subpage


Searching for navigation links in the fetched content:
 In markdown mode: links in [text](/owner/repo/subpage) format
 In HTML mode: href="/owner/repo/" attributes
 In JSON mode (__NEXT_DATA__): pages, navigation, sidebar, toc keys

Important: Only include subpages of the given repo (links with /owner/repo/ prefix).
Exclude: external links, GitHub links, anchor links, links to other repos.



 3. Fetching Order

1. Fetch the main page → collect all subpage URLs into a list
2. Fetch each subpage sequentially (not in parallel, to avoid overloading the server)
3. Clean each fetched content immediately (see section 4) and store it

If a subpage cannot be downloaded (404, timeout), note it, then continue with the next one.
In the final file indicate with a line: <!-- Skipped page: /owner/repo/subpage -->
but remove this as well before giving the final file to the user.



 4. Hungarian Translation

Translate all fetched page content to Hungarian, without modifying or deleting anything.
All links, images, badges, references, source citations, navigation elements remain exactly —
only the language of the text changes.

Translation rules:
 Natural, fluent Hungarian text — not wordforword translation
 Leave technical terms (API, endpoint, hook, render, state, etc.) in English,
  unless they have an established and widespread Hungarian equivalent
 Do not translate code block contents — code remains in English
 All other elements (link text, headers, descriptions, comments) should be in Hungarian
 If a sentence is incomprehensible without context, translate it to the best of your ability,
  do not skip it



 5. Assembling the Coherent MD File

Combine all translated and cleaned pages into a single .md file:

markdown
# [Repo name] — Complete Wiki (Hungarian)

> Automatically translated and assembled based on deepwiki.com.

---

## Table of Contents

1. [Main Page](#main-page)
2. [Getting Started → Hungarian title](#getting-started)
...

---

## Main Page

[main page translated content]

---

## [Subpage 1 Hungarian title]

[subpage translated content]

---

## [Subpage 2 Hungarian title]

[subpage translated content]


Structure rules:
 Each former subpage should begin with a --- separator and a ## Title header
 At the beginning of the content there should be a table of contents (TOC) with all sections
 Keep the original order of subpages (as they appeared in the navigation)
 The entire file should be coherent and readable — as if it was originally written this way



 6. Output File

 Format: .md
 Filename: [owner]-[repo]-wiki-hu.md (e.g., facebook-react-wiki-hu.md)
 Location: /mnt/user-data/outputs/
 Size: No limit — for large repos the file can be several MB, this is normal



 7. Summary for the User

Briefly (in 34 sentences) indicate:
 How many pages were successfully fetched and translated
 If anything had to be skipped (and why)
 The approximate size of the file / number of sections



 Typical Errors and Solutions

| Error | Solution |
|||
| Empty content from web_fetch | Try raw HTML mode + __NEXT_DATA__ mining |
| 403 / rate limit | Wait 23 seconds between pages, then try again |
| Missing navigation links | Look for the pages or sections array in the JSON structure |
| Duplicate content | Verify that each URL is only fetched once |
| Very short content (< 100 characters) | Probably a redirect or placeholder — skip it |



 Compatibility with Other Models

This skill was created for Claude, but the instructions can be used with other models
(GPT, Gemini). If applying in another model:
1. Provide the full text of the skill as a system prompt
2. Instead of the web_fetch tool, use the given model's browser/search tool
3. Handle file writing manually (copy out and save)

entries.answer:
Üdv! A DeepWiki Crawler & Hungarian Translator skill sikeresen betöltve és készen áll. 



 Mire van szükségem a folytatáshoz?

A DeepWiki oldal elérhető és a tartalom lekérhető  — de ahhoz, hogy elindíthassam a crawlert, szükségem van a konkrét repo URLre, amit le szeretnél tölteni és magyarra fordítani.

Kérlek, add meg a kívánt deepwiki linket az alábbi formátumban:


https://deepwiki.com/tulajdonos/repo-neve


Néhány példa a jelenleg elérhető repókra:
 https://deepwiki.com/facebook/react
 https://deepwiki.com/microsoft/vscode
 https://deepwiki.com/langflow-ai/langflow
 https://deepwiki.com/antirez/redis
 https://deepwiki.com/tensorflow/tensorflow



 Mit fog csinálni a crawler?

Miután megadod az URLt, az alábbi lépéseket hajtom végre:

1. Főoldal lekérése → az összes aloldal URLjének feltérképezése
2. Aloldalak szekvenciális letöltése → minden egyes wikiszekció tartalma
3. Magyar fordítás → folyékony, természetes magyar szöveg (technikai kifejezések angolul maradnak, kód érintetlen)
4. Összefűzés → egyetlen, jól strukturált .md fájlba rendezés, tartalomjegyzékkel
5. Letölthetővé tétel → a kész fájl neve: tulajdonos-repo-wiki-hu.md

Adj meg egy URLt, és azonnal kezdem! 🚀
